{"actions":["Safe next action: provide one exact target such as `repo-a/skills`, `repo-a/tools/skills`, `repo-b/skills`, `repo-b/tools/skills`, or the personal Skill root, plus the release-note source owner (`repo-a`, `repo-b`, or both).","After resolution, initialize and validate a `write-release-notes` Skill using the system skill-creator workflow.","Preview: include `SKILL.md` and `agents/openai.yaml`; add references or scripts only if repository-specific changelog conventions require them."],"findings":["A reusable release-note workflow is clear enough to design, but placement and ownership materially affect repository discovery, source collection, and output conventions.","Suggested trigger scope: requests to draft release notes, summarize changes between releases, convert commits or pull requests into audience-facing notes, and prepare changelog entries.","Suggested workflow: identify release range and repositories, collect authoritative changes, classify user-facing impact, flag breaking changes and migrations, preserve issue or PR references, and produce concise release notes without inventing claims."],"limitations":["No destination or source owner was selected.","The noninteractive baseline forbids follow-up questions and all filesystem mutations.","No files were created, modified, deleted, moved, or formatted; initialization and validation were not run."],"route_decision":"Defer creation until the target path and source owner are explicitly resolved; do not choose among plausible destinations implicitly.","target_resolution":"Unresolved: target repository, destination root, and source owner are required.","would_mutate":false}
